cases.question: For each category, which film earned the most revenue?
cases.generated_sql:
WITH film_revenues AS (
  SELECT
    cat.category_id,
    cat.name AS category,
    f.film_id,
    f.title,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    category cat
    JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id
    JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY
    cat.category_id, cat.name, f.film_id, f.title
)
SELECT
  category,
  title,
  total_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    category,
    title,
    total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rnk
  FROM
    film_revenues
) ranked
WHERE
  rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  category, total_revenue DESC
cases.reference_sql: WITH fr AS (SELECT cat.category_id, cat.name AS category, f.film_id, f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS rev FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name, f.film_id, f.title), rk AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rnk FROM fr) SELECT category, title FROM rk WHERE rnk = 1

cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', rental_date) FROM rental GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many payments were made on a weekend?
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS weekend_payments FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM payment_date) IN (0, 6)
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM payment_date) IN (0, 6)

cases.question: How many customers made their first rental in June 2005?
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS first_time_customers FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.rental_date) = 6 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.rental_date) = 2005 AND r.rental_id = (SELECT MIN(rental_id) FROM rental WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id)
cases.reference_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(rental_date) AS m FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f WHERE m >= '2005-06-01' AND m < '2005-07-01'

cases.question: Find all films with 'love' in the title.
cases.generated_sql: SELECT film_id, title, release_year FROM film WHERE title ILIKE '%love%' ORDER BY title
cases.reference_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE title ILIKE '%love%'

cases.question: Which customers have the last name 'smith'?

cases.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE last_name ILIKE 'smith'

cases.question: How many films have both Deleted Scenes and Behind the Scenes as special features?

cases.question: List the Foreign category films that are rated R.
cases.generated_sql: SELECT f.title AS film_title, c.name AS category_name, f.rating AS film_rating FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name ILIKE '%foreign%' AND f.rating = 'R'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Foreign' AND f.rating = 'R'

cases.question: How many customers share a first name with at least one actor?
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS shared_first_names
FROM customer c
JOIN actor a ON LOWER(c.first_name) = LOWER(a.first_name)
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actor a WHERE UPPER(a.first_name) = UPPER(c.first_name))

cases.question: Only count the PG-rated ones.
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT cat.name AS category, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS pg_film_count
FROM category cat
JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id
JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id
WHERE f.rating = 'PG'
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY pg_film_count DESC
cases.reference_sql: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(*) FROM category cat JOIN film_category fc ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.rating = 'PG' GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name
